TGO.note: Document covers education school census data in DHIS2, not published statistics from administrative records.
Only the annual school census is described, which is not a population census or household survey.
Disability appears only as a disaggregation of education indicators; nothing on accessible information or digital services.
StatEduc to DHIS2 interoperability is only a mission recommendation; transfer is described as manual steps today.

facts.fact: HISP Centre reports that Togo's EMIS (SIGE) runs the annual school census through StatEduc, with DHIS2 added by the Ministry of National Education as an analytical layer producing dashboards and reports for regional offices.

TGO.note: Document is about education; no health system stated.
Document is about education; no health information system stated.
Schools record on paper forms keyed by inspectorates into StatEduc once a year: a census, noted not assessed; no per-learner record kept at the school is stated.
